audit.method: Read from the full term sheet by one AI reviewer, then checked against it twice by independent AI reviewers: first every line of the record against the document, then the document section by section against the record. Not signed off by a person. Every quote is looked up in the PDF text each time the tool runs.
audit.open_points:
Final record written to C:\Users\AFarid\Documents\Hackathon\key_credit_terms\data\audited\carnival_corp_2025.json. Checker: structure OK, 75 of 75 quotes exact. A field-by-field comparison with the first-audit record shows only the two note changes above; no line, status, figure or quote was altered.

Document-to-record pass: every section of pages 1-8 was mapped to a row, and the dump was compared with page images 1-8, 12 and 13. Nothing was found missing from a row, sitting in the wrong row, or taken from the wrong facility (the Existing Revolving Facility and the two term loan agreements are kept apart from the new Facility). Every amount, ratio, date and period in the record agrees with the document. Searches for Barclays, change of control, mandatory prepayment, budget, projections, compliance certificate, EBITDA, cures, extension options, post-closing obligations and disqualified lenders all came back empty, so the five not_stated rows stand.

First auditor's doubts resolved from the document or the brief:
- info_budget stays by_reference: the affirmative covenants are 'Consistent with the Documentation Principles' and include 'other information', whereas the representations on the same page are 'limited to the following'. info_annual_obligor stays not_stated under its own field guidance.
- fc_other 'Other: none' stays stated: the Financial Covenants section is a complete numbered pair ('1. ...; and 2. ...'), not introduced by 'including' as the negative covenants are.
- Jurisdiction of Topco keeps 'United Kingdom - England and Wales': this follows the brief's own country-then-sub-jurisdiction example ('United States - Delaware'). Both Borrowers are shown because they are jointly defined as the 'Company'.
- select_definitions keeps its 'Adjusted EBITDA:' line: the brief puts 'how leverage is defined' under that prefix.
- Pricing (Annex I / I-B) has no template row, confirmed against the field list.

Doubts the document cannot resolve:
1. '75/120 days' is read as quarterly 75 / annual 120 from period end. The term sheet spells out neither, and ties the SEC later-date extension to 'delivery of quarterlies' only. Both rows say so.
2. First covenant test: 'fiscal quarter ending August 31, 2025' and 'first full fiscal quarter after the Closing Date' may not coincide. The term sheet is undated and gives no Closing Date. Both are recorded.
3. Covenant Fall-Away Event: the operative text says '(A) ... or (B)' but then refers to 'clauses (A) and (B) collectively'. The record reads it as either limb; the inconsistency is in the reviewer note only, not the printed line.
4. Survival of the financial, liens, mergers and business covenants after a Covenant Fall-Away Event is derived from their absence from the Terminated Covenants list, and is marked as derived in every row. The Negative Covenants section itself only speaks of the position 'Prior to the Covenant Fall-Away Event'.
5. Transferability: Carnival Corporation's consent right is inferred from the carve-out for payment or bankruptcy events of default; it is marked as derived.
6. Guarantors: the named list is introduced by 'including' and may not be exhaustive. The 'at least two of the Ratings Agencies' trigger was verified on page 1 but cannot be quoted within the three-quote cap.
7. Three lines exceed the ~250-character guideline (guarantors line 3 at 266, other_covenants line 6 at 286, transferability line 1 at 259). All are under the 420 hard limit and were left, because shortening would drop list items or the derived-point marker.

doc.title: Carnival Corporation and Carnival plc Revolving Credit Facility Summary of Principal Terms and Conditions
doc.notes: Undated 'Posting Version' summary of principal indicative terms for a new $4 billion senior unsecured revolving credit facility for Carnival Corporation and Carnival plc (14 pages). The terms are on pages 1-8 (sections I-IX, label column and value column); Annex I (pages 9-12) covers interest and fees and Annex I-B (pages 13-14) the ratings-based pricing grid. It is a new facility, not an amendment, so there are no existing / proposed columns; termination of the Existing Revolving Facility (February 28, 2023) is a condition precedent. Covenant, event of default and assignment detail is deferred to the 'Documentation Principles' (the Existing Revolving Facility, the 2020 and 2023 Term Loan Agreements and a February 28, 2025 indenture): no basket amounts or default thresholds are given, and no lender commitments are stated.
